But we don't have client_id, etc. We can't. So we cannot book flight. But we can compute cost. The user wants to arrange flight and check options. We can compute cost. Travel_date: last day of October 2024: 2024-10-31. Travel_class: business.

We need to get list of airports. Then pick first and last. Let's do that.
